content.short: 0xSplits provides composable, on-chain splits for ETH and ERC-20 tokens.
content.description: 0xSplits is an open-source, audited, non-upgradeable collection of smart contracts designed to efficiently split on-chain income among multiple recipients. When funds are received by a Split, each designated recipient receives their share. The design emphasizes simplicity for everyday users, security for privacy-conscious participants, and broad developer usability through a straightforward, auditable contract architecture.
content.meta: 0xSplits is an open-source, audited, non-upgradeable contract set that efficiently splits on-chain income. Discover 0xSplits and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Using Splits to Escrow an OTC Deal
resources.tldr: A neutral onchain account holds buyer funds, seller assets and collateral, then settles atomically. A clean worked example of removing a trusted middleman without adding a protocol.

resources.tldr: Getting funds to engineers, on the right chain, without handing everyone the treasury key. A short account of a pattern that keeps reappearing because the obvious answers all fail.
